spellbook.finance/limitations: The return address belongs to the signed-in person, not to a workspace. Store setup reads the workspace owner's address for returnAddressSaved.
A saved address is the text the seller typed. This read does not check that the address is deliverable.

description: Read the signed-in seller's saved return address: the name, street line, and city-state-ZIP line SpellBook prints on shipping labels, plus the other settings stored beside it. profile is null when the seller never saved one. Read it before spellbook_return_address_save, so the agent can show the seller what is on file.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

name: spellbook_return_address
